description: Diagnostic with no recipe change. It feeds the frozen keep gate (H4.6) and also settles H4.4.3. Build the E049 tip (commit 3df6233) three times, each in a fresh process with its own private TORCHINDUCTOR_CACHE_DIR. Run each build through the harness code path on fresh seeds 33–52 (benchmark.run --seed 33 --n 20) and on seeds 0–2. Record: per-seed accuracies for every build; the three 20-seed means; the per-seed differences between builds and their correlation across seeds; and mean time per build. Derive the rebuild SD σ_build of a 20-seed mean as the SD of the three means, after subtracting the expected per-seed-noise part (SD_seed/√20 × √2 for a difference). Also report E049's pooled fresh mean against its 0.7539 on reused seeds 13–32 (winner's curse, H4.4.3). Do not edit submissions/arena/. From now on, seeds 33–52 are the decision set and seeds 53–72 are reserved for one final confirmation per candidate.
